meaning_of_true: Supports interpreting the official annual indicator as transport-aviation fuel intensity using explicit official same-year/value anchors and indicator continuity; does not certify yearly operator-level matching.
other_years: Supported interpretation by continuity of the same named official indicator and common baseline; not separately redefined in each annual bulletin.
fuel_output_label: Derived/implied fuel-use estimate reconstructed from official Q and I; not an independently observed official national fuel total.
residual_uncertainty: Latest annual bulletins do not individually repeat an operator-level intensity denominator and summation rule.
The statistical system also defines general-aviation and combined-converted-tonne-km measures, which must remain distinct.
Published I has three decimal places and Q two; rounding uncertainty must be propagated/reported.
NBS values are a CAAC-derived cross-publication check, not independent sampling evidence.

evidence.notes: Passenger tonne-km uses adult weight 90 kg including baggage; children and infants use half and one-tenth of adult weight. Do not reconstruct total tonne-km as 0.09 times all passenger-km plus freight without age composition.

evidence.quote: 吨公里耗油：指平均每一运输吨公里的实际耗油量，以公斤为计算单位
evidence.notes: Transport formula: transport-flight actual fuel in tonnes / transport tonne-km × 1000. The same item separately defines general-aviation converted-tonne-km and combined average-converted-tonne-km fuel intensity. Those alternatives cannot be silently conflated.

evidence.quote: 实际耗油：指报告期运输、通用航空生产飞行过程中，航空燃油的实际消耗量
evidence.notes: Actual fuel = retained fuel after previous flight + newly fuelled amount − retained fuel after current flight. This measurement definition is not evidence that an independent national fuel total has been obtained.
